title: Fantasy Player News
description: Breaking Fantasy Football player news along with the impact for fantasy managers

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Jedrick Wills Jr. signs with Cardinals
items.desc: The Cardinals signed Jedrick Wills Jr. off the Bills practice squad.
items.impact: Wills should make an immediate impact on the offensive line for Arizona with Paris Johnson Jr. (bicep) out for the season.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: D'Shawn Jamison released by Cardinals
items.desc: The Cardinals released CB D'Shawn Jamison from their practice squad.
items.impact: Jamison will figure to seek another opportunity.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Vershon Lee released by Cardinals
items.desc: The Cardinals released OL Vershon Lee from their practice squad.
items.impact: Lee will figure to seek another opportunity.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Mark Perry signs with Cardinals
items.desc: The Cardinals signed S Mark Perry to their practice squad.
items.impact: Perry will add depth in the safety room for Arizona.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Austin Deculus signs with Cardinals
items.desc: The Cardinals signed OL Austin Deculus to their practice squad.
items.impact: Deculus will add depth on the offensive line for Arizona.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Kenny Yeboah signs with Cardinals
items.desc: The Cardinals signed TE Kenny Yeboah to their practice squad.
items.impact: Yeboah will add depth in the tight end room for Arizona.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Teagan Quitoriano added to Cardinals' active roster
items.desc: The Cardinals added TE Teagan Quitoriano to their active roster.
items.impact: Quitoriano will add depth in the Cardinals tight end room with Hunter Long placed on IR.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Hunter Long placed on IR
items.desc: The Cardinals placed TE Hunter Long on injured reserve.
items.impact: Long will miss at least the next four games. His absence will not impact fantasy managers.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Paris Johnson Jr. (bicep) placed on IR
items.desc: The Cardinals placed OL Paris Johnson Jr. on injured reserve.
items.impact: Johnson is officially out for the season after suffering a torn bicep.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: A.J. Woods signs with Bills
items.desc: The Bills signed A.J. Woods to their practice squad.
items.impact: Woods has yet to play in a regular-season game across two years in the league. He will add depth in the secondary for Buffalo.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Da'Metrius Weatherspoon released by Patriots
items.desc: The Patriots released OL Da'Metrius Weatherspoon from the practice squad.
items.impact: Weatherspoon will figure to seek another opportunity.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Al'zillion Hamilton signs with Patriots
items.desc: The Patriots signed CB Al'Zillion Hamilton to the practice squad.
items.impact: Hamilton will add depth in the secondary for New England.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Jose Ramirez released by Patriots
items.desc: The Patriots released Jose Ramirez.
items.impact: Ramirez signed with the Patriots practice squad at the start of the season. He will seek another opportunity.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Deantre Prince released by Bears
items.desc: The Bears released Deantre Prince from their practice squad.
items.impact: Prince will figure to seek another opportunity.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Elijah Jones signs with Bears
items.desc: The Bears signed DB Elijah Jones to their practice squad.
items.impact: Jones will add further depth in the secondary for Chicago.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Jaylin Lane (ankle) placed on IR
items.desc: The Commanders placed WR Jaylin Lane on injured reserve.
items.impact: Lane suffered a fractured and dislocated ankle on Sunday. He will be out for the season.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Dontae McMillan signs with Seahawks
items.desc: The Seahawks signed RB Dontae McMillan to their practice squad.
items.impact: This is the pivot after Seattle elected not to sign Joe Mixon. McMillan will add depth in the backfield for the Seahawks.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Rueben Bain Jr. (groin/shoulder) logs full practice Tuesday
items.desc: Rueben Bain Jr. was a full participant in practice on Tuesday.
items.impact: Bain remains on track to be good to go for Thursday's game against the Cowboys.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Josiah Trotter (knee) misses practice Tuesday
items.desc: Josiah Trotter did not practice on Tuesday.
items.impact: Trotter was downgraded after he was estimated as limited in practice on Monday. His status will need to be monitored in practice on Wednesday.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Ko Kieft (elbow) limited in practice Tuesday
items.desc: Ko Kieft remained limited in practice on Tuesday.
items.impact: Kieft remains off the fantasy radar.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Chase McLaughlin (groin/hip) not practicing Tuesday
items.desc: Chase McLaughlin did not practice on Tuesday.
items.impact: McLaughlin is dealing with both a groin and hip issue. His status will need to be monitored in practice on Wednesday.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Benjamin Morrison (quad) not practicing Tuesday
items.desc: Benjamin Morrison did not practice on Tuesday.
items.impact: Morrison will likely need to practice in some capacity on Wednesday to have a chance of playing on Thursday against the Cowboys.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Baker Mayfield (thumb) sidelined from practice Tuesday
items.desc: Baker Mayfield remained sidelined from practice on Tuesday.
items.impact: Mayfield remains on track to miss a second straight game for the Buccaneers.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Joey Porter Jr. (ankle) logs full practice Tuesday
items.desc: Joey Porter Jr. was a full participant in practice on Tuesday.
items.impact: Porter should be a full-go in his second game with Dallas this week.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: CeeDee Lamb (thigh) practices in full Tuesday
items.desc: CeeDee Lamb was a full participant in practice on Tuesday.
items.impact: Lamb remains a locked and loaded WR1 for Thursday's game against the Buccaneers.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Tyler Goodson (ankle) practices in full Tuesday
items.desc: Tyler Goodson was a full participant in practice on Tuesday.
items.impact: Goodson should remain in his reserve role in the Cowboys backfield behind Javonte Williams.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Tyler Smith (thumb) limited in practice Tuesday
items.desc: Tyler Smith was limited in practice on Tuesday.
items.impact: Smith continues to have a chance to return on Thursday against the Bucs. He was designated to return from injured reserve on Monday.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Drew Shelton (hamstring) misses practice Tuesday
items.desc: Drew Shelton did not practice on Tuesday.
items.impact: Shelton is trending towards being sidelined for Thursday's game against the Bucs.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: DeMarvion Overshown (hamstring) misses practice Tuesday
items.desc: DeMarvion Overshown did not practice on Tuesday.
items.impact: Overshown remains unlikely to return on Thursday against the Bucs.

items.impact: Swinson will figure to seek another opportunity.

items.impact: Smith will add depth in the secondary for Pittsburgh.

items.impact: Truss will figure to seek another opportunity.

items.impact: Pahl will figure to seek another opportunity.

items.impact: Gray will figure to seek another opportunity.

items.title: Chris Williams signs with Browns
items.desc: The Browns signed DT Chris Williams to their practice squad.
items.impact: Williams will add depth on the defensive line for Cleveland.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: James Proche II signs with Browns
items.desc: The Browns signed James Proche II to their practice squad.
items.impact: Proche played 19 games with the Browns in 2023-24. He was on Cleveland's practice squad in 2023 and earlier this season.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Lane Johnson announces retirement
items.desc: Eagles OL Lane Johnson announced his retirement.
items.impact: Johnson was a late add to the injury report last week due to personal reasons. He calls it a career after 14 years.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Kalia Davis (quad) designated to return to practice
items.desc: The Browns designated defensive tackle Kalia Davis to return to practice.
items.impact: Davis was placed on injured reserve in Week 1.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Dillon Gabriel (back) designated to return to practice
items.desc: The Browns opened the window Tuesday for Dillon Gabriel to return to practice.
items.impact: Gabriel missed the first four games on injured reserve with a back injury. He'll hold a depth role in the Browns quarterback room.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Quez Watkins signs with Colts practice squad
items.desc: The Colts signed WR Quez Watkins to their practice squad.
items.impact: Watkins will help add depth to a banged up Colts wide receiver room.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Elijah Culp released by Colts
items.desc: The Colts released CB Elijah Culp from their practice squad.
items.impact: Culp will figure to seek another opportunity.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Joe Mixon not signing with Seahawks after physical
items.desc: The Seahawks decided not to sign Joe Mixon following his physical.
items.impact: Mixon missed all of last season with a foot injury. The Seahawks will move forward with Emanuel Wilson and George Holani leading their backfield until Zach Charbonnet and Jadarian Price return.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Durham Smythe out for season with torn Achilles
items.desc: Ravens TE Durham Smythe is out for the season with a torn Achilles.
items.impact: Smythe underwent an MRI that confirmed the injury. He was in his first season with Baltimore.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Scotty Miller signs with Bears practice squad
items.desc: The Bears signed veteran WR Scotty Miller to their practice squad.
items.impact: Miller will add depth in the Bears wide receiver room. He'll remain off the fantasy radar.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Deuce Vaughn signs with Texans practice squad
items.desc: The Texans signed RB Deuce Vaughn to their practice squad.
items.impact: Vaugh was previously with the Cowboys. He'll hold a depth role in the Texans backfield.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Jamari Thrash works out for Broncos
items.desc: The Broncos worked out WR Jamari Thrash.
items.impact: Thrash had 10 catches for 107 yards with the Browns last year. He would hold a depth role in the Broncos wide receiver room.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Quinyon Mitchell (knee) hopeful to play this week
items.desc: The Eagles are hopeful to have Quinyon Mitchell back this week.
items.impact: Mitchell is working his way back from a knee injury. His status will need to be monitored in practice this week.
